doc: world/lease-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: lease lifecycle state machine, rent-run calendar, notice ladder, deposit/deduction rules, dispute schema, progression gates, and feed wording. Registry numbers (rents, tenants, units) live in jobs-housing.md §3 — this file governs how leases MOVE. All money is game dollars except credit-denominated fees marked cr (monetization §2.4/§2.8 PROPOSAL — do not contradict).

power_map.requests_pipeline: admin-domain deny — lease/rent/eviction asks are unreachable by request (moderation.json v8)
power_map.currency_wall: credits never pay rent/deposits/fees — game dollars only

states.note: unit on the board (housing.json listings_live + ladder)
application in; screening conditions evaluated (income ~2.5x, references, roommate interview)
lease offered; signing is atomic: lease row + first month + deposit + listing off board + feed event
unpaid at day 10; formal notice issued
balance cleared at any rung; back to active, arrears history retained
board filing open; notice ladder FROZEN at current rung
admin queue card — never automatic; ledger + notices + disputes on the card
tenancy ended by admin; feed 'admin' event, neutral wording
tenant notice given (30d) or lease-end; deposit return itemized
unit between tenants; flips back to listed
deed recorded; rent line replaced by tax/HOA

late_fee.note: house rule stated in every lease

rent_run.frozen_while: disputed (any rung) — no eviction while a board ruling is open

rent_control.raise_rule: controlled-unit raises need a stated basis in the ledger (annual pct or claimed passthrough); the claim is what a dispute examines

notices.name: eviction_filing
notices.trigger: window expired, no cure, no open dispute

deposits.return_rule: minus itemized deductions only — every deduction is a ledger line with a reason
deposits.informal_occupants: room shares (c2-jules, c3-dani) are person-to-person — never ledger objects

repairs.dispute_weight: open habitability item strengthens a dispute; rulings may order repair + rent credit

disputes.evidence: ledger objects only — repair requests, payment lines, claimed passthrough math; no testimony mechanics
disputes.feed: rulings are housing events, neutral wording; amounts stay in the file
disputes.live_example: bld-g9457-3 (c4-priya+c5-marcus): raise 2600->3200 contested on passthrough claim + dead heater; keep ambiguous, never resolve in content

eviction.hired_characters: not exempt — miss rent and the admin may evict (design §6)
eviction.feed_wording: admin action — tenancy ended at <address>; never the debt amount, never the reason text

owner.rule: offer at asking, first accepted wins — no bidding

feed_wording.listing_filled: Listing filled — <address> comes off the board
feed_wording.turnover: Unit turning over — <address> back on the board

demo_seed.note: lease.html demo state — mirrors jobs-housing §3; money in game $
demo_seed.viewer_character: h01 (demo hired character, tenant of bld-g9457-2)
demo_seed.day: day 6 of the month — h01's rent is in grace-lapsed; 9457-3 dispute is open
